text:
Lina: Heads-up — I'm doing a copy pass focused on conversion flow across Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. Aim: single narrative + tailored CTAs for webinar signups. Draft doc: https://drive.redwood.dev/notes/landing-copy-pass — can folks review by Wed?
Noah: Love it. Can we standardize the 'predictable throughput' phrasing? It's our sales pull. Maybe 'predictable throughput & SLAs' on Dedicated.
Alex: I'll trim the hero lines to 7 words max. Also proposing two variants for webinar CTA: 'See live benchmarks' vs 'Compare latency & cost'.
Priya: +1 on benchmarks CTA. For Private page, emphasize 'VPC & audit logs' early. Also can we add a tiny trust bar: 'SLA-backed uptime' on Dedicated.
Sam: Routing for inbound leads — if someone clicks 'Book demo' from Private page, it should route to enterprise SDR queue. Hosted demo -> product tour link. Can we map buttons?
Lina: Mapping proposal: Hosted -> /product/hosted?utm=webinar, Dedicated -> /contact/sales, Private -> /enterprise-request. @launch-bot can we make a spreadsheet row for routing?
launch-bot: Created tracking row: https://sheets.redwood.dev/landing-routes — Assigned: @Sam, deadline Tue EOD.
Alex: Quick note: hero A uses 'unified runtime' phrasing. Should we swap to 'unified inference' for clarity? Also will make webinar blurb 40-60 words.
Noah: Swap works. Small ask: add a one-liner under benchmarks about 'cost per token' comparison.
Priya: Approving this direction. I'll attach a 3-bullet talking points doc for webinar presenters.
